words.word: and the thing that is hid

occurrences.text: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
words: and the thing that is hid

occurrences.text: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
